text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(Her Highness Fine Motion was to have a 
BBQ with her friends. We, the royal guard, 
take up our posts again today—)

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
We have secured the perimeter surrounding 
the BBQ facility with tight security. I 
believe you may enjoy yourselves in 
complete safety.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work. Well then, 
shall we head out to buy the ingredients?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
When it comes down to it, it's gotta be 
meat, meat, MEAT! All the meat belongs to 
MEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, taking *all* of it isn't fair! I wanna 
eat a whole bunch of meat too~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, then to buy lots and lots of 
meat... ...Off we go!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Found it, found it! Sirloin roast! We 
shall feast on this magnificently—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wh-WHAAAT!? It got expensive!? Why, oh 
whyyyy!?!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aww man, meat's been pretty pricey lately, 
hasn't it~... What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Lately? ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's try going to another shop! 
There's a place with a wide selection of 
meats!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, huh? This shop is way cheaper! Even 
though it's the exact same cut of meat...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
......Aha, so that's it! Could it be the 
'feed'?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong♪ The feed's corn prices surged, 
which is why that previous meat was so 
expensive, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So instead, I picked a brand of meat 
raised mostly on barley. The previous shop 
didn't carry this one.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(Your Highness, what smooth and sound 
judgment...! To think you keep such close 
track of affairs that affect the people's 
daily lives...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I chopped up the vegetables~. ...Wait, 
there's no room left to put them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Then use that table over there as well! 
The caretaker said it was fine! He said 
it's surprisingly empty today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps everyone went to the new leisure 
facility nearby? Since it just opened 
today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought the crowd might flock over 
there... which is why I scheduled our BBQ 
for today. Fufu, I'm glad my prediction 
was right!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
'What enables the wise sovereign and the 
good general to strike and conquer, and 
achieve things beyond the reach of 
ordinary men, is foreknowledge'—indeed! 
Heh, another brilliant feat by Lady Fine!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...Attention all security personnel. 
Narrow the perimeter. —Yes, securing only 
Her Highness's immediate vicinity will 
suffice.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(Her situational awareness has reached 
such heights as well... At this rate, it 
is I who am lagging behind...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was so much fun! Even for me, I 
think I did pretty well today... maybe!

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Yes—the experiences you have cultivated 
here have truly borne fruit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. Coming here and spending 
time with everyone has meaning. I must 
make sure to put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...You have grown truly splendid, Your 
Highness.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, it is only natural that your 
efforts bear fruit. For you have been a 
hard worker ever since you were small—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Captain?

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, no, it is nothing. Let us return.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
(...In both mind and body, growing 
soundly. As one who works for her country, 
unwavering, fearless, you continue to 
grow.)

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
...A day will come, eventually, when I am 
no longer needed.
